points.label: Movement toward God
points.left: Jesus the Son of God is named as a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, and readers are invited to approach the throne of grace.
points.right: God’s promise and oath to Abraham lead to hope as an anchor, Jesus as forerunner, and a high priest forever after Melchizedek’s order.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: Promise and oath ground hope where the forerunner has entered

payload.tension: Both passages describe access through Jesus’ priesthood, but one stresses sympathy and need while the other stresses promise, oath, hope, and entry.
payload.title: Approach the throne and hope within the veil
